misc: Bags Miura irons and is rumoured to sleep with them.
biography: Miso, representing Hirsala Golf, has been a steadfast competitor in the Hector Trophée, having participated in ten previous editions of this esteemed pairs competition. While he will not be among the field for the upcoming Hector Trophée 2026, his continued engagement in broader Hector events affirms his enduring commitment to the series.

Across his decade of involvement, Miso has experienced the pinnacle of team success, triumphing once to claim the coveted Hector Trophée with his partner. This significant achievement underscores his prowess in the challenging collaborative format. However, the prestigious Victor Trophy, awarded for individual distinction, remains an ambition yet to be realized.

A profound connoisseur of golf equipment, Miso is particularly known for his choice of Miura irons, which he bags with an almost reverential respect. The meticulous craftsmanship of these clubs resonates deeply with his own precise approach to the game, so much so that a persistent rumor suggests his bond with them is so strong he might even keep them close by during his rest.

As the Hector Trophée 2026 proceeds without his immediate presence, Miso's unique blend of competitive achievement and dedication to his tools is a notable absence. The golfing community will undoubtedly look forward to his return to the fairways in future editions, keen to observe if his methodical style and profound connection with his equipment will once again lead to further championship contention.
